subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these refreshed third-party Action revisions in workflows that handle app credentials, release publishing, security uploads, and Codex-agent execution?
rationale: The patch is mechanically limited to immutable action pins, but deciding whether changed action implementations remain acceptable trusted suppliers is a repository-owner security-boundary decision.

options.title: Review and land refreshed pins
options.body: Rebase the PR, review the upstream action release/source changes and permissions, then merge only after checks pass on the exact refreshed head.

options.title: Split the privileged suppliers
options.body: Accept routine setup actions separately while holding token-minting, publishing, and Codex-action upgrades for dedicated supplier review.

recommendation.title: Review and land refreshed pins
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, review the upstream action release/source changes and permissions, then merge only after checks pass on the exact refreshed head.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available low-confidence routing candidate for a repository-wide trusted-workflow supplier decision.
